name: MonarchStatCard
title: StatCard
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.Surface (clickable with onClick) with androidx.compose.material3.Text, MonarchDeltaIndicator, androidx.compose.material3.TooltipBox and RichTooltip from an androidx.compose.material3.IconButton
summary: One KPI for a dashboard on a card: label, value, change against an earlier period, and an optional hint, help, trend line and drill-down, with loading, empty and error states.
whenToUse: On a dashboard or an overview screen, for a figure people check at a glance and may open for detail. Put several in a FlowRow or a LazyVerticalGrid for a KPI row.
whenNotToUse: For a number inside a row or another card without a surface of its own, use MonarchMetric (or the Plain variant). For a value with a target, use a progress or meter component.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStatCard(label: String, value: Double?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, format: MonarchMetricFormat = MonarchMetricFormat.Number, compact: Boolean = false, locale: Locale? = null, unit: String? = null, change: MonarchMetricChange? = null, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, variant: MonarchStatCardVariant = MonarchStatCardVariant.Card, size: MonarchStatCardSize = MonarchStatCardSize.Md, highlighted: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, caption: String? = null, hint: String? = null, help: String? = null, error: String? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, helpIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, sparkline: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, visual: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchStatCardLabels = MonarchStatCardLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchStatCard(label: String, text: String?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, spokenText: String? = null, unit: String? = null, change: MonarchMetricChange? = null, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, variant: MonarchStatCardVariant = MonarchStatCardVariant.Card, size: MonarchStatCardSize = MonarchStatCardSize.Md, highlighted: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, caption: String? = null, hint: String? = null, help: String? = null, error: String? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, helpIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, sparkline: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, visual: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchStatCardLabels = MonarchStatCardLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
enum class MonarchStatCardSize { Sm, Md, Lg }
class MonarchStatCardLabels(empty: String? = null, loading: String? = null, help: ((label: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: label
options.description: What the number measures, for example "Revenue".

options.name: value
options.description: The number, or null when there is none (shown as a dash read as "No data"). Not finite values count as missing.

options.name: text
options.description: Second overload: the value as written by the app, such as "₹12.4L"; spokenText gives what TalkBack reads instead.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the card.

options.name: format
options.description: Number, Percent (a ratio: 0.12 is 12%) or Currency(code), written by android.icu.text.NumberFormat.

options.name: compact
options.description: Writes 12K or €3.4M; TalkBack reads the full value.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale to write in. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: unit
options.description: Written smaller and muted after the value, for example "ms". Hidden for a missing value.

options.name: change
options.description: The change against an earlier period, drawn by MonarchDeltaIndicator, from a ratio or from current and previous values, with a good direction.

options.name: tone
options.description: Colors the value for a threshold: Info, Success, Warning or Danger. Say it in hint too: color is not read.

options.name: variant
options.description: Card: surface, border and padding. Plain: none of them, for a figure inside another surface.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm for dense rows, Md, Lg for a hero figure.

options.name: highlighted
options.description: Draws the card in the accent fill and border, to single it out (the web's accent tone).

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows a placeholder for the value; TalkBack reads "Loading".

options.name: caption
options.description: The period, for example "vs last month". It becomes the change's comparison when the change has none, and is shown alone otherwise.

options.name: hint
options.description: A line under the value, for example "38 of 52 people".

options.name: help
options.description: How the metric is defined, in a RichTooltip from a help button next to the label.

options.name: error
options.description: Replaces the value, the change and the hint with this message.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: With error, adds Try again (MonarchInlineErrorRetry).

options.name: onClick
options.description: Makes the whole card a button that drills down into the metric.

options.name: icon
options.description: A decorative icon before the label, tinted muted.

options.name: helpIcon
options.description: The glyph of the help button. Monarch bundles no icons; without it the button shows "?".

options.name: sparkline
options.description: A decorative trend under the value, for example MonarchSparkline.

options.name: visual
options.description: A decorative picture or icon at the end of the card.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces "No data", "Loading" and "About {label}".

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press, focus and hover interactions of a card with onClick.

states.name: ready
states.description: Label, value, change or caption, hint and sparkline.

states.name: empty
states.description: A missing value is a dash in the subtle text color, read as "No data"; the unit is hidden.

states.name: loading
states.description: A text-shaped MonarchSkeleton replaces the value; the change, hint and sparkline are hidden and TalkBack reads "Loading".

states.name: error
states.description: The message replaces the value, the change and the hint, in the danger color, or as MonarchInlineErrorRetry with Try again when onRetry is given.

states.name: drill-down
states.description: With onClick the whole card is a button with a ripple and a focus ring.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The accent subtle fill and the accent border.

appearance: The card uses the surface fill, the default border and 12dp corners; highlighted uses the accent subtle fill and the accent border; plain has neither. The label is muted, the value is default text in tabular figures (the strong color of the tone when one is set, the subtle color for a dash), the unit, caption and hint are muted, and an error is in the danger strong color. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on MonarchMetricFormat and MonarchMetricChange, so formatting and change follow MonarchMetric. MonarchTone has no accent tone, so the web's accent tone is highlighted = true and uses the accent roles directly. The web's legacy delta, deltaDirection and deltaTone props are not offered: change covers them with a good direction. The web's href and linkComponent become onClick (components do not navigate). The web's help Popover is a Material 3 RichTooltip from an IconButton next to the label; Monarch bundles no icons, so the button shows "?" unless helpIcon is given. The web's description-list semantics have no Android equivalent: the card is one TalkBack element instead. The web's formatOptions are not offered; write the value with the text overload for custom formats. The web's StatCardGroup is a FlowRow or LazyVerticalGrid in the app. There is no iOS equivalent yet; the names follow the plan.
accessibility: The card is one TalkBack element: label, value, change with its comparison, caption and hint.
With onClick the card is a button with a 48dp touch target that TalkBack reads as one element.
The help button is a separate element named "About {label}" with a 48dp touch target; it opens a focusable tooltip.
A compact value is read in full; a missing value is read as "No data".
While loading, TalkBack reads the state "Loading" on the card.
An error without retry is exposed as an error; with onRetry, Try again is its own button.
The icon, the visual and the sparkline are hidden from TalkBack; tone is color only, so the hint must say it.
edgeCases: A long label wraps; the card grows in height at large font sizes.
NaN and infinite values show the dash.
An empty text in the text overload shows the dash.
A tapped help button does not open the drill-down.

examples.title: KPI row with changes
examples.template:
Column(
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3),
    modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = {{groupLabel}} },
) {
    MonarchStatCard(
        label = {{cards.0.label}},
        value = {{cards.0.value|double}},
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        format = MonarchMetricFormat.Currency({{currency}}),
        compact = true,
        locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
        change = MonarchMetricChange({{cards.0.change.value|double}}),
        caption = {{caption}},
    )
    MonarchStatCard(
        label = {{cards.1.label}},
        value = {{cards.1.value|double}},
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        format = MonarchMetricFormat.Currency({{currency}}),
        locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
        change = MonarchMetricChange.between(
            current = {{cards.1.change.current|double}},
            previous = {{cards.1.change.previous|double}},
            goodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.{{cards.1.change.goodDirection|pascal}},
        ),
        caption = {{caption}},
    )
    MonarchStatCard(
        label = {{cards.2.label}},
        value = {{cards.2.value|double}},
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        format = MonarchMetricFormat.Percent,
        locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
        change = MonarchMetricChange({{cards.2.change.value|double}}),
        caption = {{caption}},
        hint = {{cards.2.hint}},
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3),
    modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = "Last 30 days" },
) {
    MonarchStatCard(
        label = "Revenue",
        value = 1_284_500.0,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        format = MonarchMetricFormat.Currency("USD"),
        compact = true,
        locale = Locale.forLanguageTag("en-US"),
        change = MonarchMetricChange(0.124),
        caption = "vs previous 30 days",
    )
    MonarchStatCard(
        label = "Cost per lead",
        value = 41.2,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        format = MonarchMetricFormat.Currency("USD"),
        locale = Locale.forLanguageTag("en-US"),
        change = MonarchMetricChange.between(
            current = 41.2,
            previous = 50.4,
            goodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.Down,
        ),
        caption = "vs previous 30 days",
    )
    MonarchStatCard(
        label = "Reply rate",
        value = 0.081,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        format = MonarchMetricFormat.Percent,
        locale = Locale.forLanguageTag("en-US"),
        change = MonarchMetricChange(0.0),
        caption = "vs previous 30 days",
        hint = "212 of 2,617 contacts",
    )
}

examples.title: A row of small cards
examples.code:
FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    MonarchStatCard(label = "Seats", value = 38.0, size = MonarchStatCardSize.Sm)
    MonarchStatCard(
        label = "Churn",
        value = 0.031,
        format = MonarchMetricFormat.Percent,
        tone = MonarchTone.Danger,
        hint = "Above the 2% target",
        size = MonarchStatCardSize.Sm,
    )
}

examples.title: Loading, then an error with retry
examples.code:
MonarchStatCard(
    label = "Signups",
    value = 1_204.0,
    error = if (failed) "The server did not answer." else null,
    onRetry = { failed = false },
)
MonarchStatCard(label = "Uptime", value = null, loading = true)
